MIDIMAN Announces Macintosh OSX Drivers for the USB MIDISport™ MIDI Interfaces

ARCADIA, Calif., July 27, 2001 – MIDIMAN, Inc., an industry leader in the development of MIDI and audio equipment, today announced the release of Mac OS X driver software for their USB MIDISport MIDI interfaces. The MIDISport trademark represents a complete line of USB MIDI interfaces manufactured by MIDIMAN. The USB MIDISport line includes the MIDISport 1x1, MIDISport 2x2, MIDISport 4x4, and the MIDISport 8x8/s, which has SMPTE read/write capability, fully programmable patchbay mode, and may be connected either by USB or serial ports on both legacy Macs and PCs.

All MIDISport interfaces will operate on USB equipped Macintosh computers using OS 8.6 or higher, and on the PC using Windows 98 or higher. Macintosh drivers include a MIDISport OMS driver. Opcode‚s OMS is required for operation on the Mac, and is included on each MIDISport driver disk. All MIDISport devices are self-powered via the USB connection, except for the MIDISport 8x8/s, which requires a power supply included with the unit. OSX drivers can be downloaded from the MIDIMAN website, www.midiman.net. All MIDISport devices are currently available and shipping. The MSRP for the MIDISport line is as follows: MIDISport, 1x1 $69.95; MIDISport 2x2, $129.95; MIDISport 4x4, $199.95, and the MIDISport 8x8/s lists for $399.95.

About MIDIMAN
Midiman Inc was established in 1988 and is based in Arcadia, California. Founded by Tim Ryan, now president of Midiman Inc., the company quickly established a reputation for expert engineering and unparalleled service. With more than a decade of success and worldwide distribution, the company now maintains a strong presence in several markets as a leading manufacturer. Midiman provides solutions in the areas of digital audio hardware, MIDI hardware, post-production, and streaming media, and enjoys significant OEM manufacturing relationships in and out of the music industry.

MIDIMAN was ranked “the top growing music industry company” by the Music Trades 2000 organization. View the entire line of MIDIMAN products on the company’s website, www.midiman.net.

Contact MIDIMAN at:
45 E. Saint Joseph St., Arcadia, CA, 91006; Tel: 626-445-2842; Fax: 626-445-7564.
